bounded_source_observations.observation: Upstream workaround is sharp>=0.35.5; reviewed lock already sharp0.35.5. Version-level Next flag remains; no runtime exploitability/image validation performed.

Upstream condition is Cache Components/use-cache functions returning typed arrays. No use-cache/cacheComponents/useCache source/config matches observed; this is not proof of nonreachability. Upstream recommends upgrade even without such functions.

Auth callback explicitly uses compact JsonWebToken RS256 allowlist, mandatory issuer/audience/expiry/subject/nonce and an independent nonce comparison; no direct JWS JSON call observed. This does not clear all Authlib advisories.
Worker uses PostgresSaver and JsonPlusSerializer(pickle_fallback=False). This does not establish that the reported Store namespace/SDK issues are unreachable or fixed.

tooling_deviation.description: Existing pnpm entry point is a Corepack shim. Fresh COREPACK_HOME unexpectedly fetched the same pnpm10.34.5 tool archive into the private cache; this exceeded the no-new-installs/tool-download intent. No application dependencies were installed and no global state/source/locks changed; root was informed and no further Corepack invocation occurred.
